command:
forge_rules=$(gh api repos/example/project/rulesets/42 | jq -e 'if (.bypass_actors | type) != "array" or (.rules | type) != "array" or .target != "branch" then error("Full branch ruleset and bypass list required") else {name,target,enforcement,conditions,rules,bypass_actors: (.bypass_actors + (if any(.bypass_actors[]; .actor_type == "Integration" and .actor_id == 123) then [] else [{actor_type:"Integration",actor_id:123,bypass_mode:"pull_request"}] end))} end') &&
printf '%s\n' "$forge_rules" | gh api --method PUT repos/example/project/rulesets/42 --input -
